record.product: Superhard materials: synthetic diamond micropowder, single crystals, diamond wire saws and grinding wheels; DCPCVD equipment and process technology
record.status_detail: Originally scheduled for implementation on 8 Nov 2025; suspended before entry into force by Announcement No. 70 and continued by Announcement No. 58 (2026) until 10 Jan 2027; key parameters: synthetic diamond micropowder average particle size <=50 um; single crystals >50 um and <=500 um; wire-saw diameter <=45 um, breaking tension <=16 N
record.source_note: Announcement No. 55 (2025) text on the MOFCOM website (republished by the Dalian free-trade zone site), and the texts of Announcement No. 70 and Announcement No. 58 (2026)
record.note: Itemised split 1 of 6 of sub-batch A aggregate row WA-POL-M-026; effective_to is the suspension expiry date, not the measure's expiry date.
